description: 2-Bedroom Refurbished Terrace House To Let A lovely two-bedroom terrace house, recently refurbished to a high standard and situated in a popular and convenient location. The property offers a fresh, modern and comfortable home, ideal for a couple, small family or working professionals. The house is ideally positioned close to local schools, shops, supermarkets and other everyday amenities, making it a very convenient place to live. There are also excellent transport links nearby, providing easy access to surrounding areas and making it ideal for commuters. With its great location, modern refurbishment and convenient access to everything you need, this property is not one to miss.
